tools.name: aitells
tools.description: AI-writing-tells score 0-99 with verdict, word/sentence counts. Rules-based, deterministic, no LLM. Input: text to check.

tools.name: aitells_report
tools.description: Full AI-writing-tells report: score, every matched tell with example sentences, style stats (em-dash rate, rule-of-three, sentence-length uniformity). Deterministic, no LLM.

tools.name: csv2json
tools.description: Convert CSV text to a JSON array of objects (first row = headers).

tools.name: json2csv
tools.description: Convert a JSON array of objects to CSV text.

tools.name: hash
tools.description: Hash text with md5, sha1, sha256 or sha512 (default sha256).

tools.name: slug
tools.description: Turn text into a URL slug.

tools.name: wordcount
tools.description: Count words, characters and lines of text.
